messages:
maya: quick sync - we need to pick a direction for the runtime facade between hosted/dedicated/private. two schools: tiny probe-based handshake vs rich feature manifest. want to capture tradeoffs and a rollout plan. thoughts?

sam: +1 tiny probe. keep adapters small. fewer runtime invariants to enforce. fallbacks handled in routing.

jin: tiny is safer for hosted but private often lacks features (kms/hsm, restricted egress). we need an explicit "unsupported" signal and a canonical fallback route so callers don't get weird errors.

alex: what about a 2-layer approach: core probe (boolean capability bits) + optional extended manifest for Dedicated/Private with extra tuning knobs (batch-shaping, kv-shard hints). example payload: ```{
  "version": "1.0",
  "capabilities": ["streaming", "kv_cache"],
  "fallbacks": {"kv_cache": "no-cache"}
}```

rachel: Dedicated customers will want to enable extra tuning. how do we prevent fragmentation where some customers rely on extended features and hosted can't serve them?

tom: prevent by making extended manifest opt-in and non-breaking. core API must have deterministic semantics; extended features only for clients that opt-in and can tolerate routing constraints.

sam: also require control plane to have a compatibility matrix and routing policy that knows which features are required for a route. otherwise silent degradations will happen.

jin: add a KMS_attestation bit so control plane refuses to route secrets to runtimes that can't attest. avoids secret-leakage footguns.

maya: rollout idea: announce manifest proto, implement probe handler, deploy to internal DevBench, then opt-in Dedicated customers behind feature flag, collect metrics for 2 weeks, then enable strict negotiation.

ops-bot: rollout checklist created: manifest-handler v0.1 -> canary 3 hosts -> monitor 15m -> scale to 10% traffic -> 24h stability.

alex: logging: when a fallback happens emit a compact human readable reason (e.g. "routed-to-no-cache: perf-risk=+15%"). helps triage and cost analysis.
rachel: can someone list the minimal core schema + example extended keys? i'll consolidate into the dedicated playbook.
maya: i'll draft a short RFC stub with core vs extended schema and a migration checklist. tagging @sam @jin for review. followups here. :)
